seerr.description:
Request management and media discovery tool for your Plex ecosystem, integrating with Sonarr and Radarr.

Based on a custom OCI image, available for amd64 and arm64 architecture.

/config.description: Configuration and database. Minimum Size: 1 Gigabyte. Should be owned by the UID:GID entered below, e.g. (1000:1000).
/config.label: Config Storage [e.g. overseerr-config]

PGID.description: Enter a valid GID to use along with the same UID. It(or the above UID) must have full permissions to the config Share mapped in the previous step.
PGID.label: GID [e.g. 1000]

PUID.description: Enter a valid UID to run Overseerr with. It must have full permissions to the config Share mapped in the previous step.
PUID.label: UID [e.g. 1000]

TZ.description: Timezone for correct request and log timestamps.
TZ.label: TZ [e.g. Australia/Sydney]
